integrity: Written proof plus independent finite mask-checking code; finite checks do not establish the all-orders theorem. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: All-orders proof assumes connected simple bipartite graphs of diameter at most three and at least three vertices. No general dimension formula is claimed. The diameter-four witness refutes all-set transfer. Publication priority outside inspected sources remains provisional.
title: Vertex–edge resolving equivalence in bipartite graphs of diameter three
